## Protocols

-   [Basic_procedure_for_Motus_array_maintnance\_&\_tags_deployment, 2026](https://uoneduau-my.sharepoint.com/:b:/g/personal/c3541851_uon_edu_au/IQC0S_P_l1ENSK_RHL_2PhpxAahaHAgEHkv0UgN3ezw8ejE?e=n6lHst)

    *Handy protocol that describes how to connect to SG receivers with a local Wi-Fi or GSM network, so you can check current time tag detection, download raw data from receivers, activate/deactivate Lotek nano-tags.*

    *Tips on tracker model decision related to ratio bird weight/tag weight so you remain under the 3% of individual body mass for equipment.*

-   [Tag_specs_and_weight_against_species_2026](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1snJpWUXllw9LFXxo-GxCXkQ45V_f5z_WSXP79ntncRA/edit?pli=1&gid=0#gid=0)

    *See what Motus Lotek , Druid or Ornitela tag you can use depending the species of shorebird you aim to equip. Find also a dynamic table for pricing and double tagging.*
